summary: Closed a recovery-side premise for the exactly-once work: the state machine writes its client-session table into the snapshot metadata (alongside index, term, membership and request) and the snapshotter restores those sessions from the decompressed stream before invoking the user payload's recover, so a node installing or restarting from a snapshot still recognises an already-applied series. Only the witness snapshot deliberately carries an empty session table, which is safe because witnesses take no client work. Recorded one knowledge entry and an explained, refuted account, noting that payload validation happens after both sections are consumed. No execution requested.
